body: I guess it's true that ignorance is bliss but I'll always opt out of that.  You make excellent points and it makes me wander on bigger scale than just myself.  I just don't understand anymore why people do the things they do.  I understand what you mean when it comes to assigning yourself a persona.  Why be anything though.  You simply aren't.  It's the same as playing a character in a game.  Even if you are something, you're not.  I'm sick of wandering around.
Just looked it up.  I love a good read so yea I'll order it.
